> Yep, I'd rather have a var instance = instantSearch(foo, bar). Not sure if we need to pass the indexName when creating the instance or later (do we handle search in multiple indices at once?)

We do need at least one indexName since one instant search interface is always targeting an index.

Then some widgets like sortOrder (sort by popularity, price ..) will need to use other indexes but it's in their APIs.
